arxiv-2103-01734.title: An analytic calculus for intuitionistic belief
arxiv-2103-01734.creator: Cosimo Perini Brogi
arxiv-2103-01734.description: Abstract Intuitionistic belief has been axiomatized by Artemov and Protopopescu as an extension of intuitionistic propositional logic by means of the distributivity scheme K, and of co-reflection A → □ ​ A A\rightarrow\Box A . This way, belief is interpreted as a result of verification, and it fits an extended Brouwer-Heyting-Kolmogorov interpretation for intuitionistic propositional logic with an epistemic modality.

arxiv-2109-08267.description: Abstract Interest in applying Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques to compiler optimizations is increasing rapidly, but compiler research has a high entry barrier. Unlike in other domains, compiler and AI researchers do not have access to the datasets and frameworks that enable fast iteration and development of ideas, and getting started requires a significant engineering investment.

arxiv-2205-07481.title: Bridging Sim2Real Gap Using Image Gradients for the Task of End-to-End Autonomous Driving
arxiv-2205-07481.creator: Unnikrishnan R Nair, Sarthak Sharma, Udit Singh Parihar, Midhun S Menon, Srikanth Vidapanakal
arxiv-2205-07481.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by Unnikrishnan R Nair, Sarthak Sharma, Udit Singh Parihar, Midhun S Menon, Srikanth Vidapanakal. Keywords

Reinforcement Learning, Sim2Real Transfer, Racecar, Computer Vision

1
Introduction

While simulations are vital for developing and testing robotic agents, the ability to transfer robotics skills learned in simulation to reality is equally challenging. Simulation to real-world transfer, popularly known as
Sim2Real
transfer, is an indispensable line of research for utilizing knowledge learned from simulated data to derive meaningful inferences from real-world observations and function in actual operational environments.

arxiv-2301-12536.title: Random points are good for universal discretization
arxiv-2301-12536.creator: F. Dai, V. Temlyakov
arxiv-2301-12536.description: Abstract There has been significant progress in the study of sampling discretization of integral norms for both a designated finite-dimensional function space and a finite collection of such function spaces (universal discretization). Sampling discretization results turn out to be very useful in various applications, particularly in sampling recovery.

arxiv-2406-07286.title: From Rank-based models with common noise to Pathwise entropy solutions of SPDEs Thanks: M. Shkolnikov is partially supported by the NSF grant DMS-2108680.
arxiv-2406-07286.creator: Mykhaylo Shkolnikov and Lane Chun Yeung
arxiv-2406-07286.description: Abstract . We study the mean field limit of a rank-based model with common noise, which arises as an extension to models for the market capitalization of firms in stochastic portfolio theory. We show that, under certain conditions on the drift and diffusion coefficients, the empirical cumulative distribution function converges to the solution of a stochastic PDE.

arxiv-2412-09724.title: Deformations of Kalck–Karmazyn algebras via Mirror Symmetry
arxiv-2412-09724.creator: Yankı Lekili, Jenia Tevelev
arxiv-2412-09724.description: Abstract . As observed by Kawamata [ 13 ] , a ℚ \mathbb{Q} -Gorenstein smoothing of a Wahl singularity gives rise to a one-parameter flat degeneration of a matrix algebra. A similar result holds for a general smoothing of any two-dimensional cyclic quotient singularity, where the matrix algebra is replaced by a hereditary algebra [ 24 ] .

arxiv-2503-11173.title: Extraction of H i gas with bulk motions in the disk of galaxies
arxiv-2503-11173.creator: Se-Heon Oh, Jing Wang
arxiv-2503-11173.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Se-Heon Oh, Jing Wang. We propose a new method for extracting bulk motion gases in the disk of a galaxy from H i data cubes, offering improvements over classical techniques like moment analysis and line profile fitting. Our approach decomposes the line-of-sight velocity profiles into multiple Gaussian components, which are then classified into (underlying and dominant) bulk and non-bulk motion gases based on criteria such as H i surface density, velocity dispersion, kinetic energy, and rotation velocity.

arxiv-2509-12134.title: How not to scramble a Rubik’s cube
arxiv-2509-12134.creator: Thomas Fernique
arxiv-2509-12134.description: Abstract We model the scrambling of a Rubik’s cube by a Markov chain and introduce a stopping time T T which is a quite natural candidate to be a strong uniform time. This may pave the way for estimating the number of moves required to scramble a cube.

arxiv-2602-14334.title: Formation and Survival of Complex Organic Molecules in the Jovian Circumplanetary Disk
arxiv-2602-14334.creator: Olivier Mousis, Clément Petetin, Tom Benest Couzinou, Antoine Schneeberger, Yannis Bennacer
arxiv-2602-14334.description: Abstract Europa, Ganymede, and Callisto are key targets in the search for habitability due to the potential presence of subsurface oceans. Detecting complex organic molecules (COMs), essential for prebiotic chemistry, is crucial to assessing their potential. Though COMs remain undetected on these moons, ESA’s JUICE and NASA’s Europa Clipper missions aim to fill this gap with their science payloads.

pmc-11859974.creator: L I Birtalan, S Bálint, T Kilencz, J M Réthelyi
pmc-11859974.description: IntroductionIn Hungary, the understanding and diagnosis of adult attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (aADHD) are influenced by a blend of international epidemiological data and the standardized criteria established in DSM-5. pmc-12619070.creator: Franco Pupulin, Adam P. Karremans, Elvira Salas Hidalgo
pmc-12619070.description: ﻿AbstractNatural hybridization in Neotropical orchids is summarized, and the frequency of nothogenera in the subtribe Zygopetalinae is highlighted. Initial evaluation revealed anemia and right-sided pleural effusion.

pmc-13191971.description: BackgroundMild traumatic brain injury (mTBI) is a common pediatric condition with growing recognition of its impact on mental health. Early identification of youth at risk for adverse mental health outcomes is essential for timely intervention.

pmc-13388773.description: Cerebral small vessel diseases (CSVDs) are a group of disorders affecting the small arteries, veins, and capillaries supplying the white matter and deep grey matter structures. pmc-13537805.title: Behavioral Patterns Behind Tobacco Smoking among Patients Admitted to a Tertiary Care Hospital of a Developing Nation
pmc-13537805.creator: Aayushi Goyal, Juhi Kalra, Aswani Kumar Seth
pmc-13537805.description: Background:Globally, more than one-fifth of smokers end up being hospitalized due to consequences.
